The 880 yards saw Jim Tosh turning out once again and he ran in quite his old form in winning in 2 min. 4 3-5 secs. Ealing did well in taking the next three places, although Frank Webb scored a couple of points by filling fifth position.

For the 4 x 880 yards we fielded a very useful side, and Jim Tosh gave us the lead over the first stage. Frank Webb went next and was forced to yield the lead to Bidwell, of Croydon; with Mitcham also on our heels, so that for the third stage the three leading runners were together.
Members will be pleased to hear that Jim Tosh, our quarter and half-mile champion of a few years past, has gained his Commission in the Queen's Regiment.

Congratulations to Jim Tosh and Tiny Jarlett, who have had awarded the British Empire Medal for bravery in air raids last winter. "F.M." is already the holder of the Police Medal for Bravery and has many "mentions" to his credit.
